function.name: EventSettingsApi_get_custom_event_specifications
function.description: Retrieve a list of all custom event specifications defined within the system. This includes details such as event names, types, and associated metadata. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

organization_id.description: The unique identifier for the organization whose event specifications are to be retrieved.

include_inactive.description: Flag to include inactive event specifications in the results.

function.name: EventSettingsApi_get_built_in_event_specification
function.description: Retrieve the details of a built-in event specification using its unique identifier. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

eventSpecificationId.description: The unique identifier of the built-in event specification to retrieve.

function.name: EventSettingsApi_get_event_specification_infos
function.description: Retrieve a summary of all built-in and user-defined event specifications available in the system. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

include_custom.description: A flag to determine whether to include user-defined event specifications in the summary. If true, both built-in and custom event specifications are included. If false, only built-in specifications are included.

filter_by_type.description: Filter the event specifications by their type. If provided, only event specifications of the specified type are included in the summary.

function.name: get_event_specification_infos_by_ids
function.description: Retrieves a summary of all built-in and custom event specifications using their unique identifiers. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

event_ids.description: An array of unique identifiers for the event specifications to be retrieved.

function.name: EventSettingsApi_get_built_in_event_specifications
function.description: Retrieve a list of all built-in event specifications available in the system. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

ids.description: A list of unique identifiers for the built-in event specifications.
